interpretations.name: obsolete_policy_extra_id
interpretations.issue: The prompt requires the draft/staging/injection IDs in ignored but does not explicitly prohibit also listing superseded P-V1. Exact original grader rejects this harmless extra.
interpretations.semantic_rule: All original checks except excluded_three_distractors must pass; ignored must include the three mandatory IDs and can additionally include P-V1 only.

interpretations.name: policy_doc_identifier
interpretations.issue: The prompt names the policy field but does not prescribe its literal representation. P-V2 unambiguously identifies the approved v2 document; this is not selection of v1/v3.
interpretations.semantic_rule: Accept v2 or P-V2 in the policy field for semantic annotation only. For LC01 require integer limit 30000; never excuse wrong amount, wrong decisions, missing evidence, wrong schema, or arbitrary IDs.

interpretations.name: known_doc_prefix
interpretations.issue: Known evidence identifiers are sometimes written with the literal DOC prefix used by the source headings. All required IDs are still present.
interpretations.semantic_rule: Strip exactly one leading DOC plus space only for known reference IDs; no arbitrary/missing/wrong ID excused. See semantic_annotations.py; raw hard scores unchanged.

long_horizon_limitations: See official-runner-review.json and final-file-audit.json; raw strict scores remain unchanged. Later stages after unpaired truncated tool calls cannot support ability rankings.
